backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the store backend, defining state and endpoints for user profiles, products, orders, carts, bills, recharge orders, and shop settings with role-based access control via AccessControl and blob storage via MixinStorage.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented features (AdminGuard session check, password login, Remember Me checkbox, etc.) to their affected files, component dependencies, and test IDs with confidence ratings.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON object containing one-to-two sentence summaries of every frontend source file, describing each component's purpose, key behaviors, and notable implementation details.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point that defines CSS custom property design tokens (colors, radius, chart colors, sidebar) for both light and dark themes using the oklch color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML shell for the React PWA, configuring viewport, theme color, PWA/Apple meta tags, manifest link, Google Fonts (Inter), and mounting the app at #root.
frontend/public/manifest.json: PWA web app manifest for Maa Bhawani General Store, specifying app name, display mode, theme/background colors, and icon references at 192×192, 512×512, and 180×180 sizes.
frontend/public/service-worker.js: Service worker implementing cache-first strategy for static assets and network-first strategy for API/canister calls, with install-time pre-caching and activation-time old-cache cleanup.
frontend/src/App.tsx: TanStack Router configuration defining all app routes, with every /admin/* route individually wrapped in AdminGuard and a public /login route rendering AdminLoginPage without a guard.
frontend/src/components/AdminGuard.tsx: A route guard component that checks for a valid admin session in localStorage or sessionStorage and redirects unauthenticated users to the login page. Also exports helpers to get and clear the admin session.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductForm: A form component for adding new products to the store, handling fields like name, category, price, barcode, unit type, stock, and image (file upload or URL). Validates inputs and submits via the useAddProduct mutation.
frontend/src/components/AdminProductList: Displays all products in a list with inline stock editing, product removal, and toggling product exclusion. Shows a low-stock alert for products with fewer than 5 units.
frontend/src/components/BarcodeScanner.t: A camera-based barcode scanner component that loads Quagga2 from CDN and uses the device camera to scan barcodes, with support for flash toggle, haptic feedback, and a beep sound on successful scan.
frontend/src/components/BillHistoryTable: Renders a searchable, filterable table of past bills with options to view, print, and export bills to CSV. Uses a dialog to display a full bill via BillTemplate.
frontend/src/components/BillTemplate.tsx: A printable bill receipt component that displays order items, totals, delivery charges, a UPI QR code, and provides buttons to print or share the bill via WhatsApp.
frontend/src/components/BottomNavBar.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with four links (Home, Search, My Orders, Wallet) that highlights the active route and uses TanStack Router for navigation.
frontend/src/components/CallUsButton.tsx: Renders a fixed circular phone button in the bottom-right corner that initiates a call to a hardcoded phone number when clicked.
frontend/src/components/CartDrawer.tsx: Displays a slide-in sheet showing the current cart items with quantities and totals, and provides clear-cart and checkout actions while respecting shop open/closed status.
frontend/src/components/CategoryFilter.t: Renders a horizontally scrollable list of category filter buttons, highlighting the currently selected category and invoking a callback on selection.
Displays a static informational alert describing the store's delivery fee policy (free above ₹51 within 1km, ₹5 below, ₹20/km beyond).
frontend/src/components/ErrorBoundary.ts: A React class-based error boundary that catches render errors and displays an alert with error details, a stack trace, and options to retry or go home.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Renders the site footer with store name, contact details (phone and Google Maps link), delivery info, and a copyright line with a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky top header showing the store logo, shop open/closed indicator, cart icon with item count, admin dashboard link, and login/logout button using Internet Identity.
frontend/src/components/HeroBannerCarous: Auto-advancing image carousel with three promotional banners, manual prev/next controls, and dot indicators that cycles every 4 seconds.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main layout wrapper that composes Header, Footer, CallUsButton, BottomNavBar, and WhatsAppHelpButton, hiding the bottom nav on admin paths.
frontend/src/components/MobileRechargeSe: A React section component that allows users to place mobile recharge orders by selecting an operator, entering a 10-digit number and amount, with form validation and a dialog UI. Disables ordering when the shop is closed.
frontend/src/components/PaymentQRCode.ts: Displays a payment card with a UPI QR code image, the amount to pay, and step-by-step payment instructions for completing a transaction.
frontend/src/components/ProductCard.tsx: Renders a single product card with image, name, category, price, stock status badges, and an 'Add to Cart' button that is disabled when the shop is closed or a mutation is pending.
frontend/src/components/ProductGrid.tsx: Displays a filterable grid of ProductCard components fetched from the backend, showing skeletons while loading and an empty-state image when no products match the selected category.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedBanner: Shows a red banner at the top of the page indicating the shop is closed, only rendered when shop status is confirmed as closed.
frontend/src/components/ShopClosedChecko: An alert dialog that appears when the shop transitions from open to closed (or is externally triggered), notifying the user and redirecting them to the home page on dismissal.
frontend/src/components/ShopStatusToggle: An admin toggle switch component that reads and updates the shop's open/closed status via mutations, displaying loading and error states.
frontend/src/components/WhatsAppHelpButt: A fixed floating button that opens a WhatsApp chat with a pre-filled message to the store's support number.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, initializing it with an authenticated identity if available and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides a React context and hook for Internet Identity authentication using DFINITY's AuthClient, exposing login/logout functions and status flags. Includes an `InternetIdentityProvider` component that persists identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines all React Query hooks (queries and mutations) for interacting with the backend actor, covering user profiles, admin checks, shop status, products, orders, recharge orders, bills, and settings like UPI ID and slogan.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, and includes utility styles for touch handling, barcode scanner animation, and print layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app wrapped in `QueryClientProvider` and `InternetIdentityProvider` into the DOM root.
frontend/src/pages/AdminLoginPage.tsx: Admin login page with hardcoded credentials that creates a session in localStorage or sessionStorage based on a 'remember me' option, then redirects to the admin panel on success.
frontend/src/pages/AdminPage.tsx: Main admin dashboard page with tabbed sections for managing orders, products, bill history, and shop status, including order status progression actions and recharge order display.
frontend/src/pages/AdminSettingsPage.tsx: Admin settings page allowing configuration of the shop slogan, UPI ID (with masking toggle), and an emergency shop-close action via a confirmation dialog.
frontend/src/pages/BillingPage.tsx: In-store billing page that allows adding products to a cart via search or barcode scan, entering customer details, and generating a printable bill.
frontend/src/pages/CheckoutPage.tsx: Checkout form page that collects delivery details and payment method, calculates totals with optional delivery fee, and places an order navigating to confirmation on success.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Main storefront page displaying a hero carousel, shop-closed banner, category filter, product grid, and mobile recharge section.
frontend/src/pages/MyOrdersPage.tsx: Placeholder page for order history that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/OrderConfirmationPage: Order confirmation page that shows the order ID, payment method, and either a UPI QR code or cash-on-delivery instructions based on the selected payment method.
frontend/src/pages/SearchPage.tsx: Placeholder page for product search that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/StoreDetailsPage.tsx: Static store information page showing contact details, hours, delivery policy, services, and an embedded Google Maps iframe.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Placeholder page for wallet/cashback functionality that displays a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, extending the default theme with custom colors (using oklch CSS variables), border radii, fonts, shadows, and accordion animations, plus typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
project_state.json: Project state tracking file (schema v1.0.0, version 3) describing a delivery app with an admin panel, documenting existing features, architectural notes around admin session security, and known critical vulnerability fixes requiring password protection and session guards on all admin routes.
